Name: Dark Skin NPCs
Author: Fapowered
Description:
A Content Patcher mod that gives all Stardew Valley NPCs dark skin tones. Includes recolored portraits and character
   sprites for 32 villagers while preserving their original hairstyles, clothing, and expressions.
  ▎ Features:
  ▎ - 32 recolored portraits
  ▎ - 32 recolored character sprites
  ▎ - Krobus left untouched (he's perfect as he is)
  ▎ - Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
  ▎ Requirements:
  ▎ - SMAPI
  ▎ - Content Patcher
  ▎ Installation:
  ▎ Drop the mod folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory.
